Title: Login with valid username and password
Steps: 1. Open /user/login 2. Enter username and password 3. Click Sign In

Title: Login with email instead of username
Steps: 1. Open login 2. Enter email and password 3. Sign In

Title: Login with wrong password
Steps: 1. Enter valid username 2. Enter wrong password 3. Sign In
Expected Result: Error 'Username or password is incorrect.'; stays on login page

Title: Login with unknown username shows same generic error
Steps: 1. Enter unregistered username 2. Any password 3. Sign In
Expected Result: Same generic error as wrong password (no account enumeration)

Title: Login with empty username
Steps: 1. Leave username empty 2. Enter password 3. Sign In
Expected Result: Form not submitted; required-field validation shown

Title: Password input is masked
Steps: 1. Open login 2. Type in password field

Title: Logout ends the session
Steps: 1. Open user menu 2. Sign Out 3. Open /repo/create
Expected Result: Signed out; protected page redirects to login

Title: Register with valid details
Steps: 1. Open /user/sign_up 2. Fill username, email, password, confirm 3. Register
Expected Result: Success message, user logged in, row in DB with hashed password

Title: Password shorter than 8 characters
Steps: 1. Fill form with 7-character password 2. Register
Expected Result: Error 'Password length cannot be less than 8 characters.'

Title: Password of exactly 8 characters
Steps: 1. Fill form with 8-character password 2. Register

Title: Password and confirmation do not match
Steps: 1. Enter different values in password and confirm 2. Register

Title: Username already taken
Steps: 1. Register with an existing username

Title: Email already used, different letter case
Steps: 1. Register with existing email in upper case
Expected Result: Error 'The email address is already used.'

Title: Malformed email address
Steps: 1. Enter 'not-an-email' 2. Register
Expected Result: Browser blocks submit; email format error

Title: Username longer than 40 characters
Steps: 1. Create user with 41-character username
Expected Result: Rejected with validation error; 40 characters accepted

Title: Reserved username
Steps: 1. Create user named 'api'

Title: Username containing a space
Steps: 1. Create user 'bad name'

Title: Create public repository
Steps: 1. + > New Repository 2. Enter name and description 3. Create
Expected Result: Repo page opens; no Private badge; API shows private=false

Title: Create private repository
Steps: 1. New Repository 2. Tick Private 3. Create
Expected Result: Private badge shown; DB is_private = true

Title: Duplicate repository name
Steps: 1. Create repo with an existing name
Expected Result: Error 'The repository name is already used.'

Title: Invalid characters in name
Steps: 1. Create repo named with space / ';' / ending '.git'

Title: Name length limit 100
Steps: 1. Type 150 characters into name
Expected Result: Field holds only 100 characters; API rejects 101

Steps: 1. New Issue 2. Leave title empty 3. Create

Title: Title of exactly 255 characters
Steps: 1. Create issue with 255-character title

Title: Title of 256 characters

Title: Title with Unicode and emoji
Steps: 1. Create issue with multi-byte title

Title: Title with HTML/script and SQL characters
Steps: 1. Create issue with <script> and SQL text as title 2. Open issue
Expected Result: Stored literally; no script runs; DB intact

Steps: 1. POST issue without credentials

Title: Create issue in a repository that does not exist
Steps: 1. POST issue to unknown repo

Title: Issue numbers increase per repository
Steps: 1. Create three issues

Title: Add a comment
Steps: 1. Open issue 2. Type comment 3. Comment
Expected Result: Comment appears in timeline; DB num_comments +1

Title: Empty comment is rejected
Steps: 1. Submit comment with empty body

Steps: 1. Open issue 2. Close Issue

Steps: 1. Reopen the issue

Title: Filter issue list by state

Steps: 1. List issues with state=bogus

Steps: 1. limit=2 page=1 2. limit=2 page=3

Steps: 1. GET issue 0, -1, 999999, abc

Steps: 1. GET /admin/users as regular user

Steps: 1. GET repo without auth

Title: Duplicate label names in one repository
Steps: 1. Create another label 'bug'

Title: UI-created issue matches DB row
Steps: 1. Create issue in UI 2. SELECT with JOIN on repository and user
Expected Result: Title, body, author, repo match exactly

Title: Repository counters match issue rows
Steps: 1. Create 3, close 1 2. Compare num_issues/num_closed_issues with COUNT(*)

Title: Deleting a repo leaves no orphan issues
Steps: 1. Delete repo 2. Count issues by repo_id

Steps: 1. Run sql/integrity_checks.sql

Steps: 1. Call user, repo, search, issue, comment, label, milestone endpoints 2. Validate each body against its JSON schema
Expected Result: Every required field present with the right type

Title: All 4xx errors share one body shape
Steps: 1. Trigger 404, 422 and 400 errors
Test Data: missing repo; bad name; bad scope

Steps: 1. POST milestone with title and description

Title: Milestone title is required
Steps: 1. POST milestone with empty, then whitespace title

Steps: 1. Link 2 issues 2. Close one 3. Read milestone

Steps: 1. PATCH state=closed

Steps: 1. Create issue with milestone 999999 2. Create issue with label 999999

Title: Comment counter follows add and delete
Steps: 1. Add 2 comments 2. Delete one
Expected Result: comments = 2 then 1; list shows the remaining one

Title: Edit a comment
Steps: 1. PATCH body

Title: Search keyword is matched literally
Steps: 1. Search w_ld 2. Search %

Steps: 1. As other user GET repo, issues, labels, raw file 2. Search for it
Expected Result: 404 everywhere; not in search, even with wildcards

Steps: 1. As other user edit issue 2. Edit and delete comment
Expected Result: 403; data unchanged when read back by owner

Steps: 1. As other user delete repo, change settings, add label/milestone, add self as collaborator

Title: No privilege escalation
Steps: 1. Promote self to admin 2. Delete admin 3. Read or mint admin tokens

Steps: 1. Render each XSS payload with /markdown 2. Parse the HTML
Expected Result: No script/iframe, on* attributes or javascript: links

Title: State change without CSRF token is rejected

Title: Session cookies and framing protection
Steps: 1. Inspect Set-Cookie and X-Frame-Options

Steps: 1. Search with quote, UNION and comment payloads

Steps: 1. Scan 9 pages with axe-core 2. Compare with baseline
